name: SkillupVR BraveSteps
summary:
SkillupVR BraveSteps is a training tool designed to help teenagers practice social interaction, communication, and self-regulation in a safe and supportive virtual environment.

The app places the user inside a realistic classroom where they interact with AI-driven teachers and students. Through guided scenarios, players learn how to:

- Stay focused and avoid interrupting
- Take turns in conversations and group discussions
- Be supportive and engaged when talking to others
- Improve timing and cooperation
